laya.description: Laya: non-autoregressive System-1 decision model (~421M encoders) that answers typed choice/score/boolean questions over text in one forward pass. Zero LLM tokens; CPU-only on this host.

repomap.description: Ranked codebase map and symbol index: PageRank over definition/reference edges rendered to a token budget. Use to pick which files to read before grepping a large or unfamiliar tree.

web.description: Cached, rate-limited internet access: Marginalia/Wiby search plus technical APIs (hn, wikipedia, stackexchange, mdn, crates, arxiv, crossref), URL-to-markdown reader, JSON shape probe. The engines this host cannot reach are documented and re-probed by `pi-web doctor`.
